_sourceCategory = Labs/Azure/WebApp "AppServiceHTTPLogs"
| json "properties", "category", "resourceId" as properties, category, resource_id
| where category = "AppServiceHTTPLogs"
| parse field=resource_id "*/SITES/*" as _, site_name
|json field = properties  "UserAgent","ScStatus","CsUsername", "SPort", "CsMethod", "CsBytes", "CIp", "CsUriStem", "ScBytes","Referer","CsHost", "Cookie", "TimeTaken" as cs_user_agent, sc_status, src_user, src_port, cs_method, cs_bytes, client_ip, cs_uri_stem, sc_bytes, cs_referrer, cs_host, cs_cookie, time_taken
| lookup latitude,longitude,country_name from geo://location on ip=client_ip
|where if ("{{site_name}}" = "*", true, site_name matches "{{site_name}}") AND if ("{{cs_host}}" = "*", true, cs_host matches "{{cs_host}}")
|count by longitude,latitude,country_name

_sourceCategory = Labs/Azure/WebApp "AppServiceHTTPLogs"
| json "properties", "category", "resourceId" as properties, category, resource_id
| where category = "AppServiceHTTPLogs"
| parse field=resource_id "*/SITES/*" as _, site_name

| timeslice 1m

|count by _timeslice
| outlier _count

_sourceCategory = Labs/Azure/WebApp "AppServiceHTTPLogs"
| json "properties", "category", "resourceId" as properties, category, resource_id
| where category = "AppServiceHTTPLogs"
| parse field=resource_id "*/SITES/*" as _, site_name
| json field = properties  "UserAgent","ScStatus","CsUsername", "SPort", "CsMethod", "CsBytes", "CIp", "CsUriStem", "ScBytes","Referer","CsHost", "Cookie", "TimeTaken" as cs_user_agent, sc_status, src_user, src_port, cs_method, cs_bytes, client_ip, cs_uri_stem, sc_bytes, cs_referrer, cs_host, cs_cookie, time_taken
| if (cs_user_agent matches "*iPad*" OR cs_user_agent matches "*iPhone*" OR cs_user_agent matches "*BlackBerry*" OR cs_user_agent matches "*SAMSUNG*" OR cs_user_agent matches "*SAMSUNG*" OR cs_user_agent matches "*Galaxy*" or cs_user_agent matches "*Windows Phone*" or cs_user_agent matches "*Android*","mobile","PC") as type
| if (cs_user_agent matches "*Macintosh*" or (cs_user_agent matches "*iMac*"),"Mac",type) as type
| lookup latitude,longitude,country_name from geo://location on ip=client_ip
|where if ("{{site_name}}" = "*", true, site_name matches "{{site_name}}")
|count by type , country_name
| transpose row  country_name column  type

_sourceCategory = Labs/Azure/WebApp "AppServiceHTTPLogs"
| json "properties", "category", "resourceId" as properties, category, resource_id
| where category = "AppServiceHTTPLogs"
| parse field=resource_id "*/SITES/*" as _, site_name
|json field = properties  "UserAgent","ScStatus","CsUsername", "SPort", "CsMethod", "CsBytes", "CIp", "CsUriStem", "ScBytes","Referer","CsHost", "Cookie", "TimeTaken" as cs_user_agent, sc_status, src_user, src_port, cs_method, cs_bytes, client_ip, cs_uri_stem, sc_bytes, cs_referrer, cs_host, cs_cookie, time_taken

| (cs_bytes/(1024)) as Kbytes
|where if ("{{site_name}}" = "*", true, site_name matches "{{site_name}}")
|avg(seconds) as response_time_sec, sum(Kbytes) as Kbytes by _timeslice

_sourceCategory = Labs/Azure/WebApp "AppServiceHTTPLogs"
| json "properties", "category", "resourceId" as properties, category, resource_id
| where category = "AppServiceHTTPLogs"
| parse field=resource_id "*/SITES/*" as _, site_name
|json field = properties  "UserAgent","ScStatus","CsUsername", "SPort", "CsMethod", "CsBytes", "CIp", "CsUriStem", "ScBytes","Referer","CsHost", "Cookie", "TimeTaken" as cs_user_agent, sc_status, src_user, src_port, cs_method, cs_bytes, client_ip, cs_uri_stem, sc_bytes, cs_referrer, cs_host, cs_cookie, time_taken
| if(sc_status matches "5*" OR sc_status matches "4*", "Error","") as Errors

|count as Count by cs_host
| sort by Count
